blocks.content: This journey uses a Grafana Pyroscope data source named `grafanacloud-play-profiles` that contains demo profiling data. The next step checks whether you already have it and helps you add it if you don't.

blocks.description: Create the grafanacloud-play-profiles Pyroscope data source when it is missing.

whenFalseSectionConfig.title: Add the play Pyroscope data source

whenFalse.content:
You don't have the **grafanacloud-play-profiles** data source yet. To continue, you need permission to create a data source on this Grafana instance, or go to [play.grafana.org](https://play.grafana.org/) where the demo data is already available.

If you can create a data source here, complete the following steps.
Open **Connections > Data sources > Add new data source**.
Select **Grafana Pyroscope** from the list of data source types.
Click the edit icon next to the data source name, then rename it to `grafanacloud-play-profiles`.
Click **Save & test**. You should see a message confirming the data source is working.

blocks.description: Return to Profiles Drilldown only when the learner is still on the data sources pages after creating the demo data source.

blocks.content:
With the data source in place, choose it by name in Profiles Drilldown.

To explore your services, complete the following steps:
If you see the **Welcome to Grafana Profiles Drilldown** onboarding page, read through it and click **X** when you're done.

blocks.description: Navigate to Profiles Drilldown only when the learner is not already there.

whenFalse.content: Open **Profiles Drilldown** on the **All services** view.

blocks.content: Open the **All services** view. If you're already there, click **Skip**.

Select **grafanacloud-play-profiles** as the **Data source**.

The **All services** view shows a chart for each service.
In the Quick filter, type `checkout` so `checkoutservice` is on screen.
Make sure the **CPU** profile type (`process_cpu/cpu`) is selected.

Optional detour: before you look into labels, open **Profile types** for `checkoutservice` to see graphs for each profile type.

The **Profile types** tab shows each profile type available for `checkoutservice`. Each panel has **Labels** and **Flame graph** shortcuts.

blocks.content: Return to the **All services** view to continue. If you're already there, click **Skip**.
